text: This is a B1 text about food. In modern society, food plays a surprisingly significant role. Although some people might dismiss it as trivial, the impact of food on our daily lives is undeniable. For instance, when we consider how much time and resources are devoted to food, it becomes clear that it shapes our cultural landscape. Personally, I have found that engaging with food has broadened my horizons and allowed me to connect with diverse groups of people.
